name: Sifted set
statement: S(A,P,z) counts or weights elements of A avoiding prime divisors p<z from P.
pvg_translation: Exact pointwise condition on truncated valuation coordinates v_p(n)=0 for p<z; aggregation may lose injectivity.
claim_ceiling: Object definition only; no asymptotic or prime production.

name: Divisibility aggregate A_d
pvg_translation: Pushforward of sequence weights through visible divisor conditions encoded by truncated valuation profiles.
claim_ceiling: Aggregate data need not recover pointwise weights.

name: Truncated valuation visibility
statement: For d<=D, all indicators 1_{d|n} and nu^(D)(n) contain the same visible pointwise divisibility information.

name: Aggregation kernel
statement: The map from pointwise sequence weights to finitely many A_d can have a nontrivial kernel.
pvg_translation: Projection modulo kernel; sign, phase, ordering, correlations, and target purity may be lost.

name: Sieve main-term certificate
statement: A usable certificate names the sequence, local density/main-term model, weights, sieve level, remainder norm, and sign status.
pvg_translation: Metadata attached to the aggregate projection; not derivable from geometry alone.
claim_ceiling: Certificate scope is exactly the named sequence and norm.

name: Level of distribution
statement: Controls aggregate remainders over moduli d up to a scale D, under a specified norm and sequence.
pvg_translation: Depth of reliable residue/divisibility-channel aggregation, not a pointwise prime guarantee.

name: One-sided sieve versus sifted asymptotic
statement: A one-sided upper/lower bound certificate is not the same as an asymptotic formula for the sifted set.
pvg_translation: Different certificate nodes over the same projected valuation data.
claim_ceiling: No certificate promotion without matching hypotheses.

name: Sifted asymptotic versus prime production
statement: A sifted-set asymptotic certificate is not a prime-producing asymptotic certificate.
pvg_translation: Target purity is extra information absent from generic divisibility avoidance.
claim_ceiling: Prime production remains unproved unless separately certified.

name: Parity barrier
statement: Classical combinatorial sieve data generally cannot distinguish integers with an odd versus even number of prime factors strongly enough to isolate primes.
pvg_translation: A limitation of the aggregate certificate channel, not merely missing valuation coordinates.
claim_ceiling: No claim of solving the parity problem.

name: Type I and Type II information
statement: Structured linear and bilinear estimates provide different cancellation certificates for sieve decompositions.
pvg_translation: Aggregate tests on valuation/residue channels with distinct correlation sensitivity.
claim_ceiling: Labels alone do not certify estimates.

name: Reject level-of-distribution to primes
statement: A stated level of distribution does not by itself imply that the target sequence contains primes.
pvg_translation: Reject certificate escalation from aggregate remainder control to target purity.

name: Reject PVG visibility to parity solution
statement: Exact encoding of divisibility data in PVG does not solve the sieve parity barrier.
pvg_translation: Representation completeness is not analytic discrimination power.
